dedupe_keys.name: e bank sampah jakarta register and locations of 7 main and 2 264 unit waste banks with customer and waste reduction counts

description: e-Bank Sampah is the Jakarta provincial environment agency's web platform for the city's waste banks, community sites where residents deposit sorted recyclables. The site read on 2026-09-28 explains that it gathers data on the activities of main waste banks and unit waste banks, records and monitors their transactions, and lists the locations of waste banks actively collecting waste, searchable by type, city, district, sub-district and neighbourhood unit. Its counters show 7 main and 2,264 unit waste banks and 570 registered customers, with waste reduction still at zero, and a news item describes its launch to support exempting residents who sort and bank their waste from the cleaning levy. The site also links the national and provincial regulations on waste banks. Coverage is the Province of DKI Jakarta. Access to the location list is free; no licence or download was seen. Caveats: the platform is new, so transaction and reduction figures were not yet populated, and the locations were not exported. It supports waste service capacity studies, such as mapping how many households each waste bank serves relative to landfill-bound waste by district. No related Jakarta waste record is catalogued.
